assertions.evidence: In subscription-check.ts the code computes oneYearAgo and compares dates (isMoreThanOneYearOld = start < oneYearAgo) and short-circuits before calling the model if false.
The request state sent to the model includes subscription_start_date: start.toISOString(), i.e., the raw date is passed along with the cancellation reason.
The model question is likely_to_return with type "noul", and the code defines LIKELY_RETURN_THRESHOLD = 0.5 and uses the noul probability to gate likelyToReturn.
